fact: Decree 26-023/PR of 2 February 2026 promulgated Law 25-021/AU, whose Article 231 requires content generated or heavily modified by AI and broadcast in the media to be clearly labelled, and Article 232 bans AI-made deceptive content such as deepfakes.
title: Décret N°26-023/PR portant promulgation de la Loi N°25-021/AU modifiant et complétant le Code de l'Information et de la Communication
